text: For a step-index optical fiber, single-mode operation requires the normalized frequency (V-number, V = 2*pi*d*NA/lambda) to satisfy which condition?
explanation: A step-index fiber supports only the fundamental mode when V < 2.405, the first zero of the Bessel function J0. V > 2.405 is the multimode regime (the swapped inequality). V < 1 is arbitrary and far stricter than required, and V = 2*pi is not a cutoff condition.
